description: Finds the EXISTING direct-message space between the authenticated user and another user, returning the space (name spaces/<id>) to send_message into. Returns HTTP 404 when no DM with that user exists yet — this tool cannot create one (creating DMs needs spaces.setup via raw_request). The user can be a Google user id (users/123...) or an email address.

user.description: The user — "users/<id>", "users/<email>", or a bare Google user id / email address.

name: find_direct_message
title: Find a direct-message space
